item.title: Horseshoe theory has become a crutch
item.description: For the illiberal far right, Jewish belonging threatens the idea of an immutable nation. For the illiberal far left, Jewish continuity is seen as a betrayal of global progress toward a homogenized universal collective. The post Horseshoe theory has become a crutch appeared first on JNS.org.

item.description: The prime minister “thanked the delegation members for their consistent support for the State of Israel, and said that Israel is the model of a true ally.” The post Netanyahu meets with bipartisan delegation of Congress members appeared first on JNS.org.

item.title: Jamaica’s quiet righteousness in the Holocaust
item.description: During a time when Jews were at great peril, a small island did what the world’s great powers refused to do. The post Jamaica’s quiet righteousness in the Holocaust appeared first on JNS.org.
